rawContent: @newsone Without @rolandsmartin  there is no @newsone. He put @newsone on the map. We need a voice for our news stories, not just entertainment on @tvonetv For  example, how #Blacklivesmatter movement was treated as opposed to the #NeverAgain movement. Both are relevant to our youth.

@strickly2001 @rolandsmartin @ChrisPaulComedy Unless we the fans of @NFL  make noise this attempt to silence the voices of young Black males will not cease. #shutupandplayball in the face of #EnoughisEnough #MarchForOurLives #StephonClark #blacklivesmatter    @nflnetwork  are you listening. #BoycottNFL a  fan.

@nowthisnews If a man never made sexual harassment an issue on the job there would be no #MeToo movement. It is about abuse of power and position to gain an advantage over another. Why can't young ladies work in an environment free of sexual harassment? #Nomoresilence

#MeToo movement must consider that unverified allegations diminishes this movement. Arbitrary and capricious can't be the rule that gives way to the exception.  Any allegation made is enough? Due process is a part of the constitution, even for men. https://t.co/oSVoYPkybW

@AP_Politics The other side of this conversation no one wants to have. Does #metoo get a pass where due process is concerned? As a victim of sexual harassment attempting to juxtapose being Black against history of failure of judicial system with no hearings at all, complicated.

@lanika @AP_Politics Just attempting to make the point that while we all are reckoning with the #metoo movement, everything isn't sexual harassment. Even the guilty deserves due process. As an African American, we know how unjust the system can be. #metoo is strengthened with constitutional norms .
